subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped Claw v1 schema and read-only planner as the core foundation now, with immutable install identity deferred to the first ownership slice?
rationale: The branch is technically substantial but creates durable CLI, manifest, provenance-adjacent, and lifecycle contracts; code review cannot determine the intended permanent product boundary or identity model.

options.title: Approve the bounded foundation
options.body: Accept the RFC direction, defer immutable install identity to the first ownership slice, and merge after the fixture and exact-head proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Require install identity now
options.body: Add an immutable install identifier to the foundational schema or plan before dependent lifecycle contracts are accepted.

options.title: Keep the stack incubating
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent stack until the RFC and complete lifecycle ownership model are accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC direction, defer immutable install identity to the first ownership slice, and merge after the fixture and exact-head proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed product-model and schema review is the strongest available evidence of ownership over the contract decision.
